    InternetAccessServiceClient
    Internal client for the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 service lifecycle: POST /internetAccess/v2/services (create), GET /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId} (get details), PATCH /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId} (update), DELETE /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId} (delete) and POST /internetAccess/v2/services/search (search).
